Independence Day with Megh
2019-03-19T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/independence-day-megh-1716370

Fashion house Megh is all set for the upcoming Independence Day celebrations with panjabis and t-shirts for boys, kameez for the girls, frocks, t-shirts and fatuas for children. These comfortable clothes are in hues of red and green that embrace the ambience of the day in various designs.

Megh's sales centres can be found in Shahbagh's Aziz Super Market, Dhanmondi's Metro Shopping Mall and a number of other key shopping spots.

For more information, please call 01611 634423 or visit www.facebook.com/meghfashionbd
